beats.say: The CocoaPods registry becomes permanently read-only from December 2, 2026, so Flutter apps still using it need to move to Swift Package Manager.
Swift Package Manager has been enabled by default since Flutter 3.44, and version 3.50 now alerts when SwiftPM has been disabled.
The fix is to check your Flutter version, re-enable SwiftPM, and do a clean iOS build to find plugins still using CocoaPods.
